content:
alex: spotted a spike of ~180 tiny GPU pods being preempted in us-west2-a over 6m. all tiny inference workers.
priya: was there any scheduled maintenance?
alex: not that I can see. noticed warm-node pool agents restarting around the same time and a conntrack jump on the rack NIC
mateo: similar pattern replicated in eu yesterday when net-agent restarted during warm-pool shrink
jen: can you grab kubectl describe + events for one evicted pod?
alex: paste below
alex: ```
NAMESPACE   NAME                        READY  STATUS    NODE            RESTARTS
ml-prod     tiny-infer-7f8d9            0/1    Evicted   us-west2-a-03   0

Events:
  Warning  Evicted  3m (x10 over 6m)  kubelet  Node had condition: MemoryPressure
``` 
alex: metrics show node memory fine; events look misleading
tomas: hypothesis: warmpool agent applies a temporary taint during drain/repair, then restarts net-agent which causes conntrack+kube-proxy churn -> readiness flips -> scheduler rebinds and packs remaining pods -> tiny pods preempted
priya: grep warmpool agent logs for taint toggles and add timestamps
alex: found toggles at 15:04:12 (taint add), 15:04:18 (agent restart), 15:05:03 (taint remove). but several nodes stayed tainted in k8s longer than the agent logs suggest
mateo: if taint stays due to API flakiness, scheduler sees fewer nodes and consolidates, triggering preemptions
jen: short-term: bump tiny pod priorityclass or temporarily increase warm pool min size; disabling preemption isn't great but can be used during mitigation window
tomas: I'll run a repro in staging: cordon/drain a warm-node while intentionally restarting net-agent, collect `conntrack -S` and `kubectl get nodes -o wide --show-labels` timeline
sre-bot: created INC-20288 (us-west2 warmpool conntrack-evict) assigned eng-platform
priya: also file a runtime bug to ensure taint is removed only after API confirms node.ready and kube-proxy stable
mateo: suggestion: decouple taint action from agent restart; add 5s gap and a conntrack-rate guard so we don't restart net-agent if conntrack rate > threshold
alex: long term: consider warm-pool dedicated racks and prefer nodes with static-net-agents during upgrades
jen: agree. add perf/pack tests to preprod to measure pack pressure when nodes temporarily disappear
alex: thx, tomas pls paste staging logs here when done
alex: :thumbsup:
